profile.migration_strategy_justification: Registry objects created through a privileged admin connection must grant complete use to the database runtime owner before the hosted writer can converge or serve them.

invariants: The current database owner can read and mutate both workflow registry tables.
The current database owner can use the workflow-version identity sequence and immutable trigger function.
No workflow, workflow version, or item row changes.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration changes only PostgreSQL privileges, refuses third-party owners, grants the database owner the exact table, sequence, and function privileges the runtime needs, and preserves every row, object owner, and schema shape.
